name: fornalytics
description: Comandos do projeto. Funciona igual no Windows, macOS e Linux.

scripts.setup: npm install && uv --directory backend sync && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:api: uv --directory backend run ruff check . && uv --directory backend run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:web: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.format: uv --directory backend run ruff format . && uv --directory backend run ruff check --fix . && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.migrate: uv --directory backend run alembic upgrade head
